title: Email Chain: RE: RE: RE: Floor 3 Lighting Budget

body.text:
FROM: Facilities <fac-104@scp.int>
TO: Site Director
SUBJECT: RE: RE: RE: Floor 3 lighting budget

Sir — third request. Forty-one fixtures on Floor 3 are past service life. My electricians will not work the containment wings after the flicker incidents, and I cannot blame them.

> Denied. Divert to Floor 6 pump maintenance.
>> Sir, with respect, if the lights fail during an observation rotation, people die.
>>> People are the one resource this site has a budget surplus of. — Dir.
[Forwarded to Ethics Committee by an anonymous account four minutes after the incident of 03:47. Delivery status: recipient mailbox decommissioned.]
